why_this_replaces_continuous_displacemen: the response estimator has a sub-pixel tail (p95 5.63 px) that no available reference can settle; a panel state is a discrete variable, so a feedback built on it is judged by counting, not by sub-pixel agreement
task_intent: an action may be dispatched only while the panel reports available, and a dispatch is wrong exactly when the panel reports unavailable, so the reward is a count of correctly gated dispatches
reference: the dispatched action record (execution stream), already recorded per step
label_rule: each statistic is compared with its own session median, which is the unbiased split for a square-wave signal

independence.why_two_statistics: the binary label is only usable if it does not depend on one arbitrary brightness threshold; two different statistics must agree on the label for nearly every step
independence.duplication_guard: if the two statistics are proportional they are the same measurement and their agreement is vacuous, so the audit reports their correlation and fails above the frozen bound
independence.forbidden: the same unvalidated detector must not both author a reward and prove its own accuracy

stop_conditions: label agreement below the frozen gate
fewer transitions than the frozen gate, which means the panel is not a usable state variable
statistic correlation above the frozen gate, which means the two statistics are one measurement
any reward component whose only reference is the same unvalidated detector
